title: CompiledExecutionPolicy
description: Compiled orchestration intent for AgentKit runtime. Advisory contract — tells Host Agent what orchestration mode, parallelism rules, retry limits, recovery cascade, and context handoff strategy the kit was designed for.

mode.description: Primary orchestration mode. direct = single agent, stage_machine = multi-step sequential, fork_join = parallel reads + sequential writes

complexity_ceiling.description: Maximum complexity level this kit supports based on topology

reads.description: Whether parallel read operations across agents are permitted

writes.description: Parallel writes are ALWAYS false — architectural invariant

max_attempts.description: Maximum retry attempts per task before escalation

same_error_limit.description: If same error signature appears this many times, skip retry and escalate

recovery.description: Ordered recovery cascade. After exhausting all entries: HARD STOP + human escalation

context.description: Default context handoff strategy between agents
